name: Surgical Grant For The Prevention Of Disability
benefit: A maximum of Rs. 6,00,000/- will be provided to Each disabled person.
eligibility_rules: The annual income of the applicant/applicant's guardian should not exceed Rs.60,000/-.The applicant should be an Indian citizen. Applicant should be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh or be a resident of the state for at least 5 yearsShould not be guilty in any criminal case.

how_to_apply:
Mode: Offline Download the application form from page no.
• 18. Fill out the application formThe following documents shall be attached to the application (a). A certificate of disability granted by a competent medical authority. (b).
